title: Weakly contractible sections preserve bounded-below total quasi-isomorphisms
statement: Let X,R,W,U and T be as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-hypercover-total]. Assume every U_p is weakly contractible in the explicit Type (u+1)-sheaf epimorphism sense of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-affine-acyclic-hypercover]. If E,F are strictly bounded-below complexes of R-module sheaves and f:E to F is a quasi-isomorphism, then T(f) is a quasi-isomorphism. No hypercover matching hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 09A2, second proof paragraph, with exact evaluation Tag 0946

proof.text: At each U_p exact evaluation preserves homology. Follow it by exact restriction of scalars along R(W) to R(U_p). The resulting functor is the section functor evaluated in simplicial degree p. Hence its map on coefficient complexes preserves quasi-isomorphisms.

Use the extension-by-zero evaluation isomorphism to identify each nonnegative outer column with the corresponding section-evaluation complex; negative columns vanish. A common lower bound for E and F gives the second lower bound on both bicomplexes. Apply bounded-below column comparison to the flipped section bicomplex map.
